glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.intro: Common terms used across Cardano, Hydra, and this SDK.

hydraHead.desc: A protocol for off-chain scalability on Cardano enabling fast, low-latency transactions among a group of participants.

utxo.desc: Unspent Transaction Output – the accounting model used by Cardano to track spendable outputs.

plutus.desc: Cardano's smart contract platform based on Haskell.

cbor.desc: Concise Binary Object Representation, a compact binary data format used for Cardano transactions.

wasm.desc: WebAssembly – a binary instruction format used for high-performance execution in browsers and Node.js.
